title: Bright light over Catalina identified as the ISS
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Bright light over Catalina identified as the ISS, about 2021 at Santa Catalina Island, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then we discovered that that bright light was the space station.

plain: Kevin Knuth, a scientist described as a NASA whistleblower, tells of a 2021 research trip near Santa Catalina Island off California, where his team watched the sky for unexplained objects with a colleague, Matthew Shadagus. Knuth says a bright light they saw turned out to be the International Space Station, and that this was written up in a scientific paper on the mission.
